verdict.rationale: Aircall documents calls, SMS and messaging in one platform tied to the CRM (aircall-docs-25), plus a shared inbox that keeps every conversation visible so the team can collaborate without losing context (aircall-docs-26). Notes are captured by AI Assistants and during dialer sessions (aircall-docs-23, aircall-docs-18), and customer context is surfaced to agents (aircall-docs-4). missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-contact threaded timeline combining calls and texts, explicit team-visible note sharing on contact records, independent or hands-on corroboration.
